caption: The drawing features an octagonal shape with a decorative, symmetrical design. The outermost border is dark green with repeating leaf-like patterns, each outlined in beige and filled with layers of pink, white, and beige. Moving inward, there is a scalloped edge colored in dark and light pink. Inside this border, the central area is a muted beige with scattered small brown dots. At the center of the composition, there is a large, stylized flower with six pointed petals. Each petal contains concentric shapes in beige, pink, dark pink, and white, echoing the colors used in the outer border. The overall composition uses primarily beige, pink, white, and dark green tones on a plain off-white background. There is cursive writing in light pencil at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Octagonal Hooked Rug
